dimensions.D1_anchor: 2 = problem anchored in a locally measured, quantified defect; 1 = documented claim only; 0 = no link
dimensions.D2_falsifiable: 2 = preregistered metric + named baseline/ablation + positive/negative/null interpretations; 1 = partial; 0 = none
dimensions.D3_reproducible: 2 = pilot produced a DISCRIMINATING measurement for this idea (a contrast or bound, not just a descriptive count) with status=completed; 1 = measurement exists but is descriptive/partial; 0 = missing
dimensions.D4_novelty: 2 = external multi-source novelty verification PASSED with cross-family reviewer receipt; 1 = local 34-paper catalogue has NO near-duplicate + explicit differentiator, but verification is UNVERIFIED (no external API / no receipt); 0 = ANY near-duplicate found in the local catalogue, or effectively duplicate (novelty risk retained)
dimensions.D5_information: 2 = result changes practice/publishable in BOTH signs with stated reason; 1 = only positive is useful; 0 = no decision value

rubric.rule: score = sum of D1..D5 (each 0/1/2), so 0-10; accept >= 8. The rubric is frozen BEFORE the first scoring run and is never changed between v1 and v2. Because no cross-family reviewer is mounted, D4 is capped at 1 for every idea; this is a ceiling imposed by the environment, not a lowered bar.
